meta.name: arsenal-expansion-mod
meta.author: Miyuyuuki
meta.description:
Made by a novice mod developer. Adds more content to the player's arsenal. Five types of tanks await your command:
                - [#FFA665[]]Assault[[]]
                - [#84F491[]]Support[[]]
                - [#BF92F9[]]Specialist[[]]
                - [#FF1414[]]Flame[[]]
                - [#FFEE00[]]Shock[[]]

                Heavily inspired by:
                - Eschatologue's 'Unlimited Armament Works'
                - nyuB's (뉴B) 'DuoMod'
                - DedShotGames' 'WOTanks'
                - Anuke's Erekir Tanks

                SFX credits to the following games:
                - Terraria
                - Terraria: Calamity Mod
                - Plants vs. Zombies
